summary: search-service response times degraded severely and then began timing out after the elasticsearch-cluster ran out of heap memory under an unexpected traffic spike.
root_cause: elasticsearch-cluster nodes hit JVM heap limits during a traffic spike, causing garbage collection pauses long enough that search-service's client timeouts triggered cascading retries, worsening the load.
fix: Increased elasticsearch heap allocation, added circuit breaking on search-service's client to stop retry storms, and added heap-usage alerting.
